WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,theSeller is the ownerinfee of a certain parcel of land,with the buildings and improvements thereon,located in the City of NewYork,Borough ofManhattan,generally known by street addresses as 349 East 104Street,NewYork,NewYork,designated as Lot 123 in Block 1676 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York,as such premises are more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (the “Seller's Land"), together with the building and improvements thereon (the“Seller's Improvements"), the Seller's Land and the WHEREAS, theDeveloper is the owner of certain parcel ofland,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by streetaddresses as2019-2021FirstAvenue,NewYork,NewYork,designated asLot23in Block 1676 on the Tax Map of the City, County and State of New York, as such premises are herein collectively called the“Developer's Land,” said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacement thereof permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer's Premises"); WHEREAS, theDeveloper intends to construct on the Developer's Land a new building (which newbuilding,togetherwith any future replacement thereof permittedpursuant to the provisions of this Agreement and applicable law, being herein called the“New Building") with bulk in excess of the bulk that is otherwise permitted on Developer's Land under the Zoning Resolution(as hereinafter defined) if such land was considered tobe a separate andindependent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to the Seller's Land which are not utilized by the Seller's Building (the “Excess Floor Area Development Rights") and are available for transfer pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS,by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously herewith (the “Declaration"), Seller and Developer have utilized the procedures available pursuant to Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to form a single zoning KL3:2498483.2 rem: 20211stAvenue , N4 - LoT 23

lot, as such term is defined in the Zoning Resolution (the“Combined Zoning Lot") for the for utilization within the New Building; WHEREAS,all partiesin interest(as defined in theZoningResolution) to theSeller's Premises and the Developer's Premises as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Royal Abstract of New York LLC ("Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit E, have joined in the Declaration or have waived their right to do so and have either executed this Agreement, or subordinated their respective interests thereto; WHEREAS, the parties hereto wish to set forth certain agreements with respect to their rights and obligations in and to the Combined Zoning Lot, as the same may be further enlarged pursuant to the terms of this Agreement and other matters, and wish to provide to the maximum extentpossibleforeachtoexerciseitsrightsinthefuturewithouthavingtoseek anyconsent, approval or other action from the other; NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of Ten Dollars ($10.00) and other good and valuable consideration,the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: 1. Certain Definitions. As used herein: A. "Business Day” means any day other than a Saturday, Sunday or other day on which commercial banks are authorized tobe closedin theState ofNewYork. B.“Bonus Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean any bonus floor area and other development rights attributed to the Combined Zoning Lot which may be available for inclusion in a building constructed thereon through the provision of an amenity or public benefit, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Zoning Resolution including, without limitation bonus floor area derived pursuant to NYC's Inclusionary Housing Program, as set forth in Section 23-90 of the Zoning Resolution. C. "Datum Level" shall mean the Datum level used by the Topographical Bureau, Borough of Manhattan,which is 2.75 feet above the United States Coast and Geodetic Survey Datum, mean sea level, Sandy Hook, New Jersey. D. "Developer'sFloorAreaDevelopmentRights"shall mean(i) theDeveloper's right to use and incorporate into the New Building (x) the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Developer's Premises, (y) the Bonus Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to the Combined Zoning Lot and (z) the Subject Floor Area Development Rights pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. E. "parties in interest, ”“use”and“bulk”shall have the meanings set forth inSection 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution.
